en.title: Chinese bike warranties and spare parts: the questions behind the headline
en.description: Separate frame warranty, unused returns, crash replacement and spare-part orders; find the real shipping, labor and claim costs before buying.
en.intro: A long warranty is reassuring. A clear answer to who ships the replacement hanger is useful on Tuesday morning. Before buying, translate the headline coverage into a support process you could actually follow.

sections.heading: Separate four different kinds of help
paragraphs: A headline warranty period answers only one question. Read the actual seller’s policy for the frame and country, then ask where a claim goes and what evidence it needs. Winspace publishes [warranty](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/warranty) and return terms separately; LightCarbon’s [warranty page](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10) also discusses crash replacement. These are different remedies.
Save the policy you were shown with the invoice. Local consumer rights may also apply; this guide is a buying checklist, not a legal ruling about any one transaction.

worksheet.caption: Four requests that need four answers
rows: Who assesses it? What proof and return route?
What condition, authorization, timing and carriage?
Is a discount offered, for whom and on what item?
Exact part reference, price and dispatch route?

sections.heading: The replacement frame is only one line of the cost
paragraphs: A replacement frame may be supplied without charge while you still face return postage, new-frame shipping, border handling and workshop labor to move the components. Ask about each line before buying. Ask whether the seller first wants photographs, a complete bike or a bare frame.

LightCarbon’s [current warranty page](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10) and [older after-sales page](https://www.lightcarbon.com/after-sale-service_n9) do not express all category and shipping conditions identically. Get the seller to identify the terms for your invoice rather than combining whichever clauses sound most generous. Never mail a component to an address from an old thread without current authorization.

sections.heading: Make a small-parts plan
paragraphs: Ask how to buy the exact hanger, seatpost clamp or wedge, headset cover, spacers and proprietary cockpit hardware. Record part numbers where available and keep a link to the current ordering route.

Discuss sensible spares with your mechanic. A spare hanger may be useful, while buying every imaginable part can waste money and still miss the one you need. Match the plan to the frame and the riding you do.
Do not assume a near-looking part is interchangeable. Have the manufacturer or qualified assembler confirm replacements, particularly for load-bearing or steering components.

sections.heading: Prepare a claim that can be understood quickly
paragraphs: Keep the invoice, model and serial details, delivery record, assembly information and clear photographs. When a problem arises, explain when it appeared, what you observed and what action you have already taken, without guessing a technical cause.

Use one issue per paragraph and request the next specific step: assessment, replacement part, return authorization or another stated remedy. Preserve the correspondence and track any relevant payment-provider deadlines.

If you suspect a structural problem, stop riding and obtain an appropriate assessment. Efficient paperwork helps the process; it does not make an uncertain component safe. The best support plan combines clear responsibility, available parts and a workshop that knows the bike.

zh-Hans.title: 中国自行车保修与备件：宣传年限背后要问什么
zh-Hans.description: 把车架保修、未使用退货、摔车折价换购与备件购买分开，买车前问清运输、工时和索赔流程。
zh-Hans.intro: 长保修让人安心，而周二早上谁来寄替换尾钩，是更具体的问题。购买前，把宣传年限翻译成真正能执行的售后流程。

sections.heading: 分开看四类支持
paragraphs: 保修宣传年限只回答一个问题。应阅读实际卖家适用于该车架及国家的政策，再问索赔送到哪里、需要哪些证据。Winspace 分别公布[保修](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/warranty)与退货条件；LightCarbon 的[保修页](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10)还讨论摔车折价换购。这些属于不同处理方式。
把付款时看到的条款与发票保存。本地消费者权利也可能适用；这是一张购车核对表，并非对某笔交易的法律裁定。

worksheet.caption: 四种需求，要分别得到答案
rows: 谁评估？需要哪些凭证，退回哪里？
成色、授权、期限、运费要求是什么？
是否提供？适用谁和哪件商品？
准确料号、价格和发货方式？

sections.heading: 替换车架只是费用中的一行
paragraphs: 即使厂家免费提供替换车架，旧架退运、新架寄送、边境处理和车店移装工时仍可能由你承担。购买前逐项问清，再问卖家初步评估需要照片、整车还是裸架。
LightCarbon 的[当前保修页](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10)与[较早售后页](https://www.lightcarbon.com/after-sale-service_n9)对某些类别与运输条件的表述不完全相同。请卖家明确发票适用哪份条款，别把最宽松的句子拼在一起。没有当前退货授权，别按老帖地址寄件。

sections.heading: 给小配件做个计划
paragraphs: 问准确尾钩、座管夹或楔块、碗组上盖、垫圈及把组专用硬件怎么买。有料号就记录，并保留当前订购渠道。
和技师讨论合理备件。备用尾钩可能有用，但所有想得到的都买一遍，也可能花钱却仍漏掉真正需要的。按车架和骑行方式安排。
别假设长得像的配件能互换，尤其承重和转向部件，应由厂家或合格装配者确认替换。

sections.heading: 准备一份能快速看懂的索赔说明
paragraphs: 保留发票、型号与序列信息、交付记录、装配资料及清晰照片。出问题时，说明何时出现、观察到什么、已经做过什么，不要先猜技术原因。
一段写一个问题，并明确请求下一步：评估、补件、退货授权或其他补救。保存往来，注意相关支付平台时限。
怀疑结构问题时停止骑行，取得适当评估。材料清楚有助流程，却不能让不确定部件变安全。好的售后方案，需要责任明确、配件可得，以及了解这辆车的技师。
